description: Find a ready-made automation recipe for a plain-words need, e.g. 'when a typeform is submitted add a row to google sheets and send a slack message'. Returns the best matching recipes (apps chained with →, what it does, the n8n workflow JSON, the blanks to fill and accounts to connect) plus matching public n8n templates (title + official link). Covers connecting apps, automating a workflow, syncing tools, and getting notified when something happens.

need.description: What should happen, in plain words. Start with 'when …' for the trigger.

name: find_recipe

items.description: One step: text, kind (trigger/action), the chosen tool or a gap; reversibility = read-only (changes nothing) / reversible (undo by hand) / irreversible (sends, posts, deletes, pays — out in the world), and approval_gate (an Approve/Decline message runs first).

public_templates.description: public n8n templates: title + official link

recipes.description: matching tested recipes, each with its n8n workflow, blanks and accounts

title: Find a ready-made automation recipe
